iframe.title: Loading...
iframe.allow: fullscreen; autoplay; gamepad; clipboard-read; clipboard-write; web-share; accelerometer; gyroscope
iframe.srcdoc:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Loading...</title>
  <style>
    html, body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    #test {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      border: none;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <iframe id="test"></iframe>

  <script>
    const urls = [
      "https://testingcf.jsdelivr.net/gh/sealiee11/arctic@main/index.html",
      "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/sealiee11/arctic@main/index.html",
      "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sealiee11/arctic/main/index.html",
      "https://cdn.statically.io/gh/sealiee11/arctic@main/index.html"
    ];

    const loaderScript = `
      <script>
        (() => {
          const urls = ${JSON.stringify(urls)};
          const redirectUrl =
            "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/OrangeesDev/MathWork@main/DuckGame2.svg";

          let i = 0;

          function tryNext() {
            if (i >= urls.length) {
              document.body.innerText = "Could not load Arctic.";
              return;
            }

            const url = urls[i++];
            const controller = new AbortController();
            const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 7000);

            fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal })
              .then(response => {
                if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Load failed");
                return response.text();
              })
              .then(html => {
                if (!html.includes("arctic-root")) {
                  throw new Error("Invalid page");
                }

                html = html.replace(
                  /<head>/i,
                  '<head><base href="' + new URL(".", url) + '">'
                );

                clearTimeout(timer);
                document.open();
                document.write(html);
                document.close();

                function redirectAllClicks(event) {
                  const target = event.target;

                  if (!(target instanceof Element)) return;

                  const clickable = target.closest(
                    'button, a, input[type="button"], ' +
                    'input[type="submit"], input[type="image"], ' +
                    '[role="button"], [onclick], summary'
                  );

                  if (clickable) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    event.stopImmediatePropagation();
                    window.location.href = redirectUrl;
                  }
                }

                document.addEventListener(
                  "click",
                  redirectAllClicks,
                  true
                );

                document.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
                  const target = event.target;

                  if (
                    (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") &&
                    target instanceof Element &&
                    target.matches(
                      'button, a, [role="button"], summary'
                    )
                  ) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    event.stopImmediatePropagation();
                    window.location.href = redirectUrl;
                  }
                }, true);

                document.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(input => {
                  if (
                    input.type === "text" ||
                    input.type === "search" ||
                    input.type === "url"
                  ) {
                    input.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
                      if (event.key === "Enter") {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        event.stopImmediatePropagation();
                        window.location.href = redirectUrl;
                      }
                    }, true);
                  }
                });
              })
              .catch(() => {
                clearTimeout(timer);
                tryNext();
              });
          }

          tryNext();
        })();
      <\/script>
    `;

    document.getElementById("test").srcdoc = loaderScript;
  </script>
</body>
</html>
